title: Verification Engineer
description:
Verification Engineer


Salary to £60k + benefits

Hybrid role - 3 days a week (Tues, Wed, Thurs) on-site in Witney, Oxfordshire,


NB: Please only apply if you are eligible for SC clearance (i.e. you have min 5 years continuous UK residency and are a British national).


Company


Pioneering safeguards for embodied-AI, this company is building the trust layer for autonomy and physical AI. They aim to be the global leaders in novel control assurance, pioneering trusted and ethical autonomy for humanity. Their software enables assured, trustworthy deployment of both traditional deterministic autonomy and AI or novel control methods, in any application, for the first time. They do all of this with no need for data or communications links, and they begin the journey by applying their tech to autonomous systems in the aerospace and land domains.


The Role


As part of a highly specialised engineering team, you will contribute to the design, development, verification and certification of embedded safety-critical systems that provide assurance and runtime safety functions across autonomous platforms. The platform is being developed providing mathematically verifiable software foundations suitable for the highest levels of safety assurance.


Successful candidates will work across:


Safety-critical embedded software development

Runtime assurance architectures

Autonomous flight safety systems

Mission assurance and control systems

Verification and validation activities

Certification-focused software engineering

Safety monitoring and fail-safe architectures

Airworthiness and autonomy assurance frameworks


The engineering team is focused on delivering solutions that support highly regulated autonomous operations, including SORA-based operating environments and future certified autonomous aviation systems.


Responsibilities


Define and execute verification strategies for safety-critical software and systems.

Develop test frameworks, verification plans and certification evidence.

Support software verification activities aligned with DO-178C objectives.

Perform requirements-based verification and validation.

Support certification artefact generation and traceability.

Conduct integration, system and qualification testing.

Work closely with software engineers to ensure compliance with safety objectives.

Support the maturation of the company’s assurance framework and verification capability.

Demonstrate leadership in achieving the company’s certification objectives.


Must-Have Experience


Strong background in safety-critical verification and validation.

Understanding of advanced software verification and testing methodologies, such as automated testing, fuzz testing, Monte Carlo simulation, fault injection, or other techniques used to validate the robustness and safety of complex embedded systems.

Experience working within regulated engineering environments.

Understanding of software lifecycle and verification processes.

Experience with requirements-based testing and traceability.

Knowledge of embedded systems and real-time software.

Experience generating certification evidence and compliance documentation.


Desirable Experience


DO-178C verification experience.

Automotive (ISO26262 / IEC65108).

DAL-A or DAL-B programme experience.

Aerospace, defence or autonomous systems background.

Formal verification or static analysis experience.

Real-time verification tooling for safety-critical projects including SIL, HIL, SIH.

Verification of flight control or mission-critical systems.

Knowledge of SORA, airworthiness or aviation certification frameworks.

Experience supporting autonomous aircraft, UAV or UAS programmes.


Other Stuff


NB: Please only apply if you are eligible for SC clearance (i.e. you have min 5 years continuous UK residency and are a British national).


Salary to £60k

Hybrid role - 3 days a week on site in Witney, Tues, Wed, Thurs

Benefits include; EV Car Scheme, Cycle to Work Scheme, Company socials, Thursday in-office lunch on them, 25 days holiday


NB: for non-UK Citizens; we cannot accept applications from anyone requiring sponsorship (now or in the future) for UK permanent employment status. If you are utilising a work visa this must allow you to work in the UK unrestricted for at least the next 5 years.
